usage.callShape: POST https://gg402.vercel.app/language_translator with JSON body {text, source_lang, target_lang}
usage.outputShape: Expected translated text but endpoint returns body.status=\"ERROR\" with body.error.message and body.error.code (HTTP 500). No usable result field.
quirks: BROKEN charge-then-fail: charges $0.01 USDC on Base then returns HTTP 500 'GOOGLE_TRANSLATE_API_KEY not configured. Please set GOOGLE_TRANSLATE_API_KEY environment variable.' — backend is missing its upstream Google Translate key.

Body schema is {text, source_lang, target_lang} (all strings) — NOT the sibling /translate_text shape {text, target_language}. Sending target_language returns HTTP 400 'Validation failed' naming source_lang/target_lang as required.
Pre-payment probe shows 402 (looks payable) but every call charges and then fails. Money is lost on every call.
Both validation errors AND the final 500 are returned with body.status='ERROR' and body.error.{message,code}.
Same root cause as the ai-translate /translate_text route (missing GOOGLE_TRANSLATE_API_KEY). Do NOT call until provider fixes server config.
usage.guide: Do not call this endpoint. A POST to https://gg402.vercel.app/language_translator with body {text, source_lang, target_lang} debits $0.01 USDC on Base and then returns HTTP 500 with body.error.message 'GOOGLE_TRANSLATE_API_KEY not configured' because the backend is missing its Google Translate upstream key. The correct body shape (verified) is {text, source_lang, target_lang} — sending the sibling shape {text, target_language} returns a 400 validation error — but even with the right fields no translation is ever returned. Treat as dead until the provider fixes their server config.
